title: [spec-gap][R-APXM-001] RD registration payload divergent (CBOR vs link-format); RD absent in Rust/C
description: Requirement (spec/appendix-misc.md C.1): POST coap://[6lbr]/rd?ep=node-001&lt=86400 with Content-Format: application/link-format payload. Normative owner: spec 07 10.6, appendix-senml F.15. Classification: DIVERGENT, high confidence. Evidence: Python RD decodes the registration body as CBOR only (_decode_single_cbor, python/src/lichen/coap/resources/resource_directory.py:280; docstring :127-128) - no application/link-format registration decode path exists, while lookup /rd-lookup/res (resource_directory.py:357-392) emits link-format only via Accept:40 and defaults to CBOR 60. RD is mounted opt-in (build_site(resource_directory=True), site.py:51) and absent entirely from Rust (rg /rd|rd-lookup|ResourceDirectory over rust/ clean) and C (lichen/ clean). Tests: python/tests/coap/test_resource_directory.py (TestRdPost :53), test/vectors/coap_rd.json via TestResourceDirectoryVectors (test_vector_files_consume.py:569-800). Same divergence classified in R-07-046 and R-08N-015, never beaded. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/resource_directory.py - accept application/link-format (RFC 9176 default, CF 40) alongside CBOR; rust/lichen-gateway and lichen C gateway - mount /rd + /rd-lookup/res for 6LBR conformance. Open question (see appendix-misc-flagged.md): whether spec should instead be amended to the CBOR profile Python implements.
